run_make_submission_file: run the CLI script to merge OC20 or OC22 split results into a single evalAI submission NPZ file
run_write_predictions: run write_predictions to merge multiple split NPZ result files into one compressed submission file
run_write_is2re_relaxations: run write_is2re_relaxations to extract IDs and energies from .traj trajectory files for IS2RE submissions
run_main: run main to validate dataset splits and orchestrate writing the final submission file
run_hybrid_is2re: run the script with --hybrid to write IS2RE results from S2EF prediction NPZ files instead of trajectories
